description: An agent applies the same instruction to each file that matches a glob. Night Shift then commits all changes at once.

inputs.name: glob
inputs.label: Files
inputs.description: A glob, relative to the project folder, for example `src/**/*.ts`.

inputs.name: instruction
inputs.label: Instruction
inputs.description: What to change in each file.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.command:
set -e
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
	echo 'Nothing changed.'
	exit 0
fi
git commit -m "per-file: {{glob}}" -m "{{instruction}}" -m "{{each.summary}}"
